spanish: Y Egipto conocerá que yo Jehová, en mi extender mi mano sobre Egipto, y haré salir a hijos de Israel de medio de ellos.
grammarChanges: Moved 'Egipto' before the verb and matched it with singular agreement (conocerá) so Egipto reads as the one who knows, not as the object known; the implicit, unnamed plural subject is removed.
readerNote: Chose singular Spanish verb agreement with the proper noun Egipto as subject, since Hebrew construes מִצְרַיִם with a plural (3cp) verb as a collective ('the Egyptians') while the Spanish proper noun Egipto takes a singular verb.
